about.description: <0>Hi, I’m Atai, a passionate Frontend Developer with a keen eye for detail and a strong foundation in JavaScript, React, and modern web technologies.</0><0>With a deep understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and frameworks like React and Redux, I specialize in building intuitive and responsive web applications.</0><0>My goal is to continue growing as a developer, eventually stepping into a senior frontend role where I can lead projects and mentor others.</0><0>I hold a bachelor degree in Information Systems and Technologies from KNITU-KAI and have attended advanced programming courses at 'School 21' by Sberbank.</0><0>I am deeply committed to writing clean, maintainable code and believe in the importance of continuous learning. Books like 'Clean Code' by Robert Martin and 'Effective TypeScript' by Dan Vanderkam have greatly influenced my development philosophy.</0><0>Feel free to reach out if you’d like to collaborate on a project, discuss job opportunities, or just chat about the latest in frontend development!</0>
education.knitu.name: KNITU-KAI
education.knitu.description: Gained a strong foundation in database management, object-oriented programming (C#), and system programming (C/C++). Studied algorithms and data structures (stacks, queues, linked lists, arrays), applying them to real-world problems.
education.school21.name: School 21
education.school21.description: Studied C/C++ programming with a focus on multithreading, synchronization (threads, semaphores, mutexes), and network programming (sockets). Developed small projects, applying core computer science principles and enhancing problem-solving skills.

work.myack.ziphy.description: <0>• Developed a multi-step online form with real-time data validation, pagination, and PDF generation, streamlining user interactions.</0><0>• Implemented a multi-stage patient booking system, allowing users to seamlessly switch stages and save data, improving eﬃciency by 40%.</0><0>• Integrated Google Maps to dynamically display the nearest hospitals, enhancing accessibility for users.</0>

work.myack.labq.description: <0>• Designed interactive charts to visualize patient medical data, enhancing clarity and decision-making for doctors.</0><0>• Built an interactive body map to visualize medical conditions and health indicators with greater clarity.</0>

work.welbex.amocrm.name: AmoCRM
work.welbex.amocrm.description: <0>• Developed and integrated 10+ custom features into AmoCRM, including Google Drive, Yandex Disk, and third-party services, streamlining workflows and boosting business eﬃciency.</0><0>• Migrated legacy JavaScript components to React, improving maintainability and reducing future development time by 30%.</0><0>• Collaborated with backend engineers, testers, designers, and product managers to align technical solutions with business goals.</0>

work.proxyone.description: <0>• Developed responsive, SEO-optimized websites and admin dashboards, improving site accessibility and UX.</0><0>• Enhanced website performance, increasing PageSpeed score from 69% to 100%.</0><0>• Managed project deadlines, improving task planning and execution.</0>
